title: Authentication email address
purpose: Review one account email address and its verification state.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Requires an active account with both Staff and Superuser status. A laboratory admin role, Staff status alone or individual authenticator or email-address model permissions granted to a user or group do not open this page.

items.label: Verified
items.description: Whether the account holder confirmed they receive mail at this address.

items.label: Primary
items.description: Whether this is the account’s preferred address.

items.label: Close
items.description: Returns to the email address list without changing anything.

items.label: History
items.description: Opens Django administration history for this record.

items.label: Home / app / model breadcrumbs
items.description: Return to administration home, the application module or the email address list.

items.label: View site
items.description: Header link to the operational application. Log out submits immediate sign-out.

sections.title: Related records
paragraphs: These sign-in addresses are separate from client contacts and report recipients. Account holders change and verify them from their own Email addresses page.
